news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.23 (vs ₹0.23 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.23 (in line with 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹108.4m (up 6.0% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹6.62m (down 3.1% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 6.1% (down from 6.7% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 24% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 1% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.
